prompt: On 30 October 2026, with which Xcode did an upload to App Store Connect have to be built?

choices.text: Any Xcode, if the app targets iOS 13

choices.text: Xcode 27.1 exactly, the current release
choices.why: The rule is a minimum, not one version.

choices.text: Xcode 15, the version that introduced the requirement
choices.why: That was the 2024 minimum.

prompt: A contractor only writes code and uploads builds. Which App Store Connect role does the section suggest?

choices.text: Account Holder, shared with them
choices.why: There is one Account Holder, and it is not shared.

choices.text: Developer
choices.why: Right: enough to upload, no more.

choices.text: App Manager, the only role that can upload
choices.why: Developer can upload too.

prompt: In Apple's definition, data is collected when it is transmitted off the ___ and kept longer than the request needs.
The planner syncs the plan to its own server, which stores it under the person's account. What does its label say?

choices.text: Nothing collected, since it is the planner's own server
choices.why: Your own server storing data is collecting.

choices.text: Collected and linked, not used to track
choices.why: Right: stored under an account, shared with nobody.

choices.text: Collected and used to track
choices.why: Tracking is sharing with others for advertising.

choices.text: Collected but not linked to the person
choices.why: Account data is linked.

prompt: An SDK's privacy manifest says it collects device identifiers. The app's label says no data is collected. Who is right, and what happens?

choices.text: The label, since it is the app's own statement
choices.why: The app's statement has to include its SDKs.

choices.text: Neither matters: only the manifest is read
choices.why: People read the label; App Review reads both.

choices.text: The manifest; the label has to say so too
choices.why: Right: the two have to agree, and this mismatch is what review looks for.

choices.text: The label, if the SDK was added by a contractor
choices.why: Who added it changes nothing.
